selector.rationale: Annular gray hyperkeratotic plaques with atrophic centers and elevated edges, along with histopathological findings of hyperkeratosis and parakeratotic columns, are characteristic of lichen sclerosus.

rejected.label: psoriasis
rejected.why: Lack of silvery scales and other typical psoriatic features

rejected.label: Darier's disease
rejected.why: Absence of characteristic suprabasal acantholytic dyskeratosis

rejected.label: seborrheic keratosis
rejected.why: Clinical presentation and histopathology do not match seborrheic keratosis

rejected.label: Grover's disease
rejected.why: While some features overlap, the specific combination of clinical and histopathological findings better supports lichen sclerosus
